notes.title: NBA 2K26 Gameplay Update (September 22, 2025)
notes.content: [p]We will be releasing an update that improves contest coverages, based on gameplay data and community feedback. This update will be applied automatically around [b]September 22 at 2 AM PT[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Join the official Discord to get notifications for patch notes and key announcements, and to share game feedback.
